div.div: صَمِرٌ : [Stinking; having a foul, or an offensive, odour, or smell]. One says, يَدِى مِنَ السَّمَكِ صَمِرَةٌ [My hand is stinking from the fish], (S, O, [in the former of which the meaning is indicated by the context,]) and مِنَ اللَّحْمِ [from the flesh-meat]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
